description: Add a teloxide-based Telegram bot to the Axum backend for admin control (commands via group + DM) and push notifications (artist uploads, stream events). Bot shares Arc<AppState>, runs as a tokio::spawn alongside the HTTP server.

decisions.crate: teloxide (most mature Rust Telegram crate, derive macros for commands, inline keyboards, native tokio integration)
decisions.bot_scope: Group chat + DM — restricted to a single admin chat ID in config
decisions.notifications: Single admin chat ID from env var — fire-and-forget, errors logged but never propagated
decisions.instagram_account: Config-driven — TELEGRAM_INSTAGRAM_ACCOUNT env var, defaults to 'prod', no runtime prompt
decisions.polling: Long-polling over webhooks — simpler deployment, no extra endpoint/TLS, fine for admin-only traffic
decisions.architecture: Bot instance stored in AppState as Option<teloxide::Bot> so notification helpers can reuse it without recreating the client
decisions.refactoring: Extract shared logic from API handlers into service-layer functions (ai.rs, video.rs) so both HTTP handlers and Telegram commands call the same code

decisions: /help — list all commands with descriptions
/artists — list unassigned artists (name, date, track count, emoji status)
/shows — list upcoming shows (date >= today, assigned artist count)
/artist <id> — single artist details (name, tracks, socials, bio status, video status, caption status)
/show <id> — single show details (title, date, artists, cover status, recording status)
/generate_bio <artist_id> — trigger AI bio + Instagram caption generation
/generate_videos <artist_id> — trigger track preview video generation
/preview_instagram <artist_id> — send caption text + profile image to chat
/edit_caption <artist_id> <new caption> — update instagram_caption in DB
/post_instagram <artist_id> — publish artist to Instagram (config-driven account)
/post_show_instagram <show_id> — publish show cover to Instagram
/stream_status — check if stream is active + who is streaming
/stats — summary: total artists, unassigned count, upcoming shows, stream status
